name: Get!
source:
Main character is going to participate in school festival competition for couples with the ultimate prize of 1 million yen. He needs the money to secure funds for his game production circle. But first he needs to find a girlfriend.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公打算参加学园祭上的情侣竞赛，终极大奖高达100万日元。他需要这笔奖金，为自己的游戏制作社团筹措资金。不过在此之前，他得先找到一名女朋友。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
